notes: Timeline = audio/song.wav (the album version; stems from it, no offset). Tempo is constant: 160.997 BPM (period 0.37268 s), fitted over the whole cut on drum+mix onset envelopes, phase refined on kick attack times; first beat in the song 0.095 s. The grid (beats, downbeats) starts 9 beats before the song, at the TV cut's bar 0, so bar numbers match it. First downbeat -3.259 s; bar k starts at first_downbeat + k*4*period. Envelopes: 100 fps, frame i centred at i/100 s, 46 ms RMS window, one-pole smoothing (10 ms attack / 90 ms release), each divided by its own 99th percentile and clipped to 0..1 (linear amplitude). low <150 Hz, mid 150-2000 Hz, high >4 kHz of the full mix; vocal/drums/bass/other = Demucs stem RMS. Onsets [time, strength 0-1] from the drums stem: kick = <120 Hz attacks (376); snare = 1.5-5 kHz attacks with a loud noise tail (384); hat = >7 kHz attacks away from snares and kicks (330). vocal = onset-strength peaks of the vocal stem.
